committed_before: any A4c fit, profile, fallback, error-budget, input-convergence solve or held-out score; no A4c code exists at registration
parents: docs/phase8_r2_plan.md (P8-R2; P8.7 stages incl. stage 4 combustor fitting stay intact)
outputs/phase7/p72_registration.json (objective, weights, budgets, identifiability rule, held-out metrics)

known_A4_facts.note: already-known committed aggregates; never optimization or selection targets; A4 is not rescored
known_A4_facts.A4_unreachable_cause: both Trent 1000-E records (11RR052, 12RR058) fail at the design point from the single registered guess

model.name: A4c
model.status: new prospective model; not a corrected A4 score
model.physics: P8.4b three-shaft cycle with the P8.4b-A1 handling-bleed rule, unchanged: scripts/phase8/trent_p84b.py make_engine and offdesign_point and cpp/catjet_core/offdesign.* are reused without edits
changes_from_A4: nozzle coefficients from P8.3-A2: Cd 0.96, Cv 0.985 (core and bypass)
input-only design initialization: ordered starts, first closure-valid converged candidate

fixed_inputs.fuel: p72_registration.json fuel.mole_fractions (Dooley 2012 Jet A surrogate), liquid basis -360 kJ/kg
fixed_inputs.maps: pyCycle 4.4.0 export, data/maps/pycycle_4.4.0 (fan FanMap, IPC LPCMap, HPC HPCMap, HPT/IPT HPTMap, LPT LPTMap)
fixed_inputs.public_inputs: ICAO OPR, BPR and rated thrust of each record (physical inputs, not fitted)

T4_K.central_source: Martinez, Aerospace engine data (UPM): Trent XWB maximum TET 1800 K (sister engine, published specification only)
T4_K.bounds_source: P8.4b sensitivity range (engineering endpoints; outer 1500-2200 K envelope from the Trent 1000-A performance study, ResearchGate 329944773)

FPR.bounds_source: upper 1.55 Martinez table (older lower-BPR engines); lower 1.40 engineering choice (P8.4b)

eff_comp_offset.applies_to: added to fan, IPC and HPC design isentropic efficiency centers
eff_comp_offset.central_source: pinned pyCycle 4.4.0 HBTF generic values (IPC = LPC)

eff_turb_offset.applies_to: added to HPT, IPT and LPT design isentropic efficiency centers
eff_turb_offset.central_source: pinned pyCycle 4.4.0 HBTF generic values (IPT = HPT)

cooling_scale.applies_to: multiplies NGV 0.0641 and rotor 0.0275 HPT cooling fractions
cooling_scale.central_source: NASA CR-168189 section 3.2.3 design values (other-machine rig)
cooling_scale.bounds_source: 0 = no cooling (limit), 1 = cited design (P8.4b range rule)

shared_parameters.per_engine_free_parameters: none; every fitted parameter is shared across all engines
shared_parameters.certification_year: not used; only if cited metadata is later prospectively registered; ICAO test dates are never substituted

calibration_data.ignored: every other column (old v6 predictions and diagnostics) is never parsed
assertions: file sha256 equals the registered value
forbidden_readers: any read of data/icao_engine_data.csv target columns before the score reservation
calibration_data.pool_choice: frozen 93-row Trent calibration split (9 groups, effective N 27), not the 12-family cross-family pool (no steering received)

objective.definition: SSE = sum_i w_i e_i^2, e_i = (FF_pred - FF_ICAO) / FF_ICAO; the existing group-balanced relative fuel-flow objective (lto_v5.residual_vector)
objective.unreachable: a row whose design point has no valid start, whose continuation or bleed solve fails, is status 'unreachable' with its reason and e = 1.0 (lto_v5.FAILED_ROW_ERROR)
objective.exceptions: any other exception aborts the run (not caught)
objective.evaluation: one design solve + thrust continuation per unique (OPR, BPR, rated thrust) record key, only the modes present, parallel over keys (ProcessPoolExecutor, default 6 workers); deterministic

candidates.name: tpe_then_polish
candidates.start: Optuna TPESampler(seed 42), 150 trials over the box in shared_parameters.order; then polish from the best trial
candidates.value: min(polished SSE, best-trial SSE) exactly as lto_v5.fit

fit.evaluation_order: candidate 1, 2, 3 in one process (same model object)
fit.selection: lowest calibration SSE; exact ties: tpe_then_polish, then polish_from_central, then polish_from_midpoint
fit.records: every candidate, its start, polish status, nfev, box-scaled J^T J condition and the full evaluation log are written; no extra budget, no held-out choice

profile.grid: uniform numpy.linspace over each parameter's bounds
profile.inner_fit: the same least_squares polish over the other free parameters
profile.warm_start: as lto_v5.profile: from the grid point nearest the optimum upwards, then downwards, each inner fit started from the previous grid point's solution, the first from the optimum
profile.D: n_eff * ln(SSE_profile / SSE_min), SSE_min = min(fit SSE, profile minimum)
profile.rule: IDENTIFIED iff D >= 3.841 at both box edges (95 % interval interior on both ends) AND interval width <= 50 % of the box width
profile.penalty_guard: lto_v6.apply_penalty_guard reused exactly: no verdict-deciding grid point may carry an unreachable calibration row or an unknown count; n_unreachable taken from the objective log at the returned optimum, re-evaluated once if absent (as lto_v6.run_profile)
reported_not_gating: grid step and grid points inside each interval
box-scaled J^T J condition at the optimum
every failed profile and verdict of the original pass
profile.A1: PASS iff every fitted parameter of that pass is IDENTIFIED under the rule and the guard

fallback.trigger: the primary profile leaves at least one parameter not IDENTIFIED
fallback.action: jointly fix ALL unidentified parameters at their cited central values; refit the remaining parameters with the same three registered starts (TPE seed 42 150 trials + polish, central, midpoint of the remaining box) and budgets; profile the remaining parameters once with the same settings
fallback.no_further_search: no second fallback, no adaptive grid, no change of bounds
fallback.if_none_remain: no refit; the model is all-fixed at cited centrals; report 'all fixed, A1 n/a', not a fitted identifiability success
fallback.verdict: the primary A1 verdict is the A4c A1 verdict; an A1 FAIL stays a failure and G2 stays closed; the fallback verdict is reported beside it
fallback.frozen_model: primary fit if primary A1 PASS; otherwise the fallback fit (or all-central if none remain), whatever the fallback profile verdict

design_initialization.scope: every A4c design solve (fit, profile, error budget, input convergence, score)
design_initialization.starts_order: for d in (280, 220, 340): for FAR in (0.03, 0.02, 0.04): W = rated_thrust_N / d
design_initialization.selection: FIRST candidate in order that is converged and closure-valid; never by observed fuel flow or lowest fuel-flow error; all tries retained
design_initialization.solver: unchanged C++ damped Newton: max scaled residual < 1e-10 within 50 iterations, existing bounds
closure_valid: W, FAR, Wfuel, Fn_N, Tt3, Tt4, A_core_m2, A_byp_m2 finite and > 0
every station W, Tt, Pt finite and > 0
design_initialization.no_valid_start: design status unreachable with all tries and reasons

input_convergence.parameters: A4c central prior (shared-parameter centrals, P8.3-A2 Cd/Cv, fixed inputs above)
input_convergence.scope: representative design scope: the lowest eligible UID of each of the 20 eligible families in outputs/phase8/cross_family_split.json, plus BOTH original Trent 1000-E input records 11RR052 and 12RR058 (UIDs deduplicated); not all 89 eligible records

readers.databank: scripts/phase8/icao_families.read_sheet_columns (whitelisted identifier/design columns; target columns never decoded); xlsx sha256 must equal cross_family_split.json xlsx_sha256 57a9ff572458ad3a3141afc1aea932b5faa5796d279f0ac74600b27869302530; split content_sha256 recomputed
readers.trent_1000_e: data/icao_engine_data.csv read with usecols = Unique ID, Engine ID, Mode, Pressure Ratio, Bypass Ratio, Rated Thrust (kN) only (sha256 511ec57a31c4621e1f76754e3c92dbd6c7c151a4cfd0fcdb7f40c9ce6b34d7a7)

input_convergence.eligibility: unchanged registered rule (docs/phase8_family_split.md); no eligibility change based on solves

sources.Trent 7000: certified 2018 under EASA TCDS E.036 as a Trent 1000 variant; Rolls-Royce Trent 7000 product page (three-shaft)
sources.D-36: Ivchenko-Progress/Motor Sich D-36 three-shaft (secondary public description)

three_shaft.builder: trent_p84b.make_engine (three-shaft path) with A4c central overrides; IPC/HPC split by the Trent 8/14 stage-count rule used as a declared proxy for non-Trent three-shaft families

two_shaft_direct.source: manufacturer two-spool architecture (public descriptions); no three-shaft member

geared_two_shaft.proxy: LOSSLESS gearbox design-power proxy: fan and LPC on the LP power balance with normalized speeds, which equals a lossless fixed-ratio gearbox at the design point; Hbtf has no gearbox field; no geared off-design validation claim

architecture_policy.two_shaft_builder: existing C++ two-shaft Hbtf path (production thermo) at alt 0, M 0, dTs 0 on the pyCycle US 1976 table; LPC share of ln(core PR) = ln 1.935 / ln(1.935 * 9.369) from the pyCycle HBTF example (generic, declared); HPC bleeds cool1/cool2/cust = 0; HPT cooling = cited NGV/rotor into cool3/cool4
architecture_policy.two_shaft_proxy_limits: the existing two-shaft C++ path has no P8.3 Cd/real-gas choking law (pyCycle Cv nozzle, Cv 0.985), no eta_b temperature-rise scaling (full HP equilibrium) and no ISA override (US 1976 table at 0 m); no C++ edit is authorized, so these differences are declared limits of a convergence check, not a model claim

input_convergence.gate: coverage == 20 families AND every case (including both Trent 1000-E records) has a converged closure-valid design; no family skipped, no missing binary or databank treated as PASS, convergence never inferred from initialization
input_convergence.known_static_risk: offdesign.cpp solve_design bounds W to 1000 lbm/s (453.6 kg/s) on the two-shaft path and 3000 lbm/s (1360.8 kg/s) on the three-shaft path; large two-shaft families (e.g. GE90, GEnx-1B, CF6-80, PW4000) and possibly Trent XWB may need more inlet flow. This is a source reading, not a result; any failure is recorded, not tuned, and changing the bounds needs a separate C++ registration

error_budget.engine: AE3 Trent 1000-AE3 02P23RR126 (calibration engine) only; modes TAKE-OFF, APPROACH, IDLE
baselines: old_A4_central: trent_p84b.solve_engine with trent_p84b.CENTRAL exactly (Cd 0.96, Cv 0.95, single registered guess); compared with outputs/phase8/p84b_a1_g1.json ae3_central (reproduction, old files untouched)
old_A4_central_new_builder: A4c builder with the old A4 nozzle and single guess (builder regression)
new_central_prior: A4c builder at the A4c central prior with ordered design starts
error_budget.per_case: re-solve the design, freeze its geometry, solve the three modes by the registered continuation
reported: FF per mode and delta vs new central
AE3 calibration error and its change in percentage points
design and mode residual norms and iterations
error_budget.share_diagnostic: share_m = (change of AE3 calibration error in pp caused by the intervention) / known A4 aggregate_m with aggregates TO 15.4, APP 10.3, IDLE 8.3 (%). ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY: not an additive causal allocation of held-out errors; shares are not claimed to sum to 100 %; central values are not tuned by them; no held-out row is inspected

heldout_score.rows: the original 87 Trent held-out rows of outputs/phase6/split_p61.json (heldout_records, heldout_groups)
heldout_score.deadline: by 2026-10-15 (America/New_York); otherwise reported in progress; no deadline-driven retuning
preconditions: this registration and docs/phase8_p83_a2_registration.json committed and clean
A4c implementation sources committed and clean
fit, profile and (if triggered) fallback fit/profile records committed and clean
outputs/phase8/p84_input_convergence.json committed and clean (its verdict is copied into the score; a FAIL is reported, not hidden)
frozen parameter, source and input identities computed from those committed files
AC power and no other heavy job
heldout_score.reservation: outputs/phase8/ladder/A4c/heldout_score_reservation.json is created atomically (exclusive create) BEFORE any held-out target is read; it holds the frozen parameters and identities; it is retained even if scoring fails; its existence refuses any later score
heldout_score.target_reader: lto_v5.load_rows(split heldout_records, with_targets=True) + attach_groups, called only after the reservation exists
heldout_score.metrics: unchanged: lto_v5.holdout_tables with the v6 base registration (group-weighted MAPE, record-level, per mode, B0, B1, unreachable APE 100 %), lto_v6.a4_informativeness
heldout_score.interpretation: if A1 FAILs, the score of the frozen failed model is diagnostic only and never opens G2

outputs.write_once: every file is created exclusively; an existing file refuses the step

runtime_gates.processes: no other Python process running benchmark, ladder, v6/v5 calibration, trent_p84b or any A4c script (parked shells ignored); ps unreadable = refuse
runtime_gates.sources: registration and implementation files committed and clean at HEAD; HEAD or git status unreadable = refuse
runtime_gates.launch_order: set by the main workflow record (after the benchmark, A2 and Track 4 AC chain); these scripts never launch themselves
